name: Brant

tierList.prydwen: T1.5 ToA / T4 Whimpering Wastes (DPS role); T1.5 ToA / T2 Whimpering Wastes (Hybrid role)

kit.intro: 5-star Fusion Sword Hybrid, plays almost entirely mid-air. Forte gauge 'Bravo' (0-100, filled via Basics/Intro/Skill) unlocks enhanced Resonance Skill 'Returned from Ashes' (big Basic-Attack-type nuke + shield). Also heals/shields the party for free. Ultimate scales flat ATK off excess Energy Regen (up to 280%).

skills.normalAttack: Captain's Rhapsody - ground and mid-air 4-hit chains with grapple-swing/flip mechanics; holding Basic triggers automatic backflips + charged attacks for fast Bravo gain.
skills.resonanceSkill: Anchors Aweigh! - AoE Fusion DMG launch; becomes Plunging Attack variant mid-air if Bravo not full.
skills.forte: Ocean Odyssey - Theatrical Moment/'My' Moment (flat ATK scaling with ER over 150%), Waves of Acclaims (party heals at Bravo thresholds), Returned from Ashes (100-Bravo enhanced nuke + shield).
skills.liberation: To the Horizon - AoE Fusion DMG + party heal, enters Aflame state (doubles Bravo gain rate).
skills.intro: Applaud for Me! - Fusion DMG + grants Interlude Applause (next Mid-air Attack starts at stage 2).
skills.outro: The Course is Set! - next character gains 20% Fusion DMG Amplify + 25% Resonance Skill DMG Amplify for 14s.

bestWeapons: Unflickering Valor (signature, 100%, required for his best set)
echoSet: Tidebreaking Courage (best but needs 250%+ ER, typically requires signature)

mainStats.cost3: Energy Regen; Energy Regen / Fusion DMG

teams.name: Team #1: Best Team (Mono Fusion)
teams.notes: Lupa's Outro (Basic+Fusion DMG Amp) is Brant's best buffer; Mornye lets him run Hypercarry-style while keeping Lupa's Mono Fusion buffs.

teams.name: Team #3: Skill-DPS pairing
members: Verina (required with Jinhsi for Coordinated Attacks)
teams.notes: Brant's Outro amplifies Resonance Skill DMG, pairing well with Skill-focused DPS.

teams.name: Team #4: DPS Brant
teams.notes: Double Forte rotation builds Bravo twice for a concentrated burst window; lower average DPS than standard but very high peak damage.

rotation: Standard: Intro -> (optional Skill cancel-Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Mid-air Basics P2-P3 with flips/charged attacks -> Forte (Returned from Ashes) -> Outro. Double Forte DPS variant pre-builds Bravo before the main damage window to cast Returned from Ashes twice under a single buff window.
communityNotes: Prydwen: excellent Outro buffer and viable multi-DPS/solo-DPS pick, mostly airborne (dodges many ground attacks for free) with built-in team sustain (heal+shield); biggest downside is extremely steep Energy Regen requirements (250-280%) largely gated behind his signature weapon Unflickering Valor, making him one of the hardest characters in the game to build well without it. Best home is Mono Fusion with Lupa.
